annotations.title: IP address lookup: location, network owner, reverse DNS

description: IP geolocation / IP address lookup: city, region, country and coordinates, the network's ASN and organisation, reverse DNS, and whether the address is public, private or reserved. IPv4 and IPv6. Location data from DB-IP Lite (CC BY 4.0, credited), updated monthly; location is the network's registered place, never a street address. Input: ip. $0.02 per call. Returns: ip, version, scope, reverse_dns[], location{city, region, country, country_code, continent, latitude, longitude}, network{asn, organization}, database_month, attribution{text, url, license}, notes[], checked_at.

ip.description: One IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_ip_lookup
